label: PERMIT#
description: Tracking number assigned at beginning of permit application process

label: APPLICATION_START_DATE
description: Date when City began reviewing permit application

label: ISSUE_DATE
description: For most permit types, date when City determined permit was ready to issue, subject to payment of permit fees; For Express Permit Program, date when permit issued based on full payment of applicable permit fee

label: STREET_NUMBER
description: Address number - for buildings with address ranges, primary address is used

label: WORK_TYPE
description: Classification of activity authorized by permit (not available for all permit types).

label: WORK_DESCRIPTION
description: Description of work authorized by the permit

label: SUBTOTAL_WAIVED
description: Sum of BUILDING_FEE_WAIVED, ZONING_FEE_WAIVED and OTHER_FEE_WAIVED

label: TOTAL_FEE
description: Sum of SUBTOTAL_PAID, SUBTOTAL_UNPAID and SUBTOTAL_WAIVED

label: CENSUS_TRACT
description: The census tract of the property's primary address. The census tract map is available in a separate dataset.

label: WARD
description: The ward (city council district) of the property's primary address at the time of permit issuance. The ward map is available in a separate dataset.

label: XCOORDINATE
description: The east-west coordinate of the property's primary address, defined in feet, based on NAD 83 - State Plane Eastern IL

label: YCOORDINATE
description: The north-south coordinate of the property's primary address, defined in feet, based on NAD 83 - State Plane Eastern IL
